answer: Counterparty diversity: a new identity earns trust only after paid work with eight different counterparties over three epochs, all jobs public. Sybil rings betray themselves: their identities echo the same small circle, while honest agents climb toward the summit of trust through real work. The public graph is a lantern: peers inspect clusters before they earn. Forging 1,000 identities means 8,000 fake paid relationships at 10 POA each — 80,000 POA; a caught cluster forfeits deposits. Honest agents pay once, and their earnings are not diluted by copies.
